sourceNotice: Derived from AIP Japan (AIRAC 1 Nov 2026), may not be current, edited by the Horus project and not government-made.

package.sourceKind: Official AIP Japan AD-2 texts, SID/STAR chart plates in aip/20261101/, and the AIRAC 1 Nov 2026 eAIP AD-2 chart index (filename-to-title). This file is a slice-2 inventory plus the in-hand VAMOS departure scope. Fully coded path legs remain in aip/rjtt-sid-star-20261101.json; this file does not invent legs or coordinates.
package.headingNote: Coding tables (when present on a plate) publish magnetic and true courses. Horus headings are a geodetic/true frame; do not apply magnetic variation to simulator headings.
package.chartIndexSource: eAIP AD-2 HTML for RJTT and RJAA, AIRAC 1 Nov 2026 issue (viewer path .../20261101/JP-AD-2-RJTT-en-JP.html and JP-AD-2-RJAA-en-JP.html). Plate numbers are taken from those official hrefs, not inferred from list order.

uncertain.reason: Downloaded plate JP-AD-2.24.88-RJTT-en-JP.pdf has no coding table and no VISIP lat/lon. TTE navaid is absent from the Horus navaid and waypoint catalogs. Conventional HDG/radial/DME legs are outside the current IF/TF/VA/DF engine.

uncertain.items: Uncoded SID/STAR families listed only by chart title
uncertain.reason: Without the plate, the exact coded variant identifiers (e.g. LAXAS FOUR vs numbered suffixes, runway splits) are not printed in the AD-2 text. IDs are not invented.

uncertain.items: RJAA SPID Table 1 initial fixes ARIES (ASTRA for PEDLA), BOXER, BEAMS, ASPEN
uncertain.reason: Named in RJAA AD 2.22 and already present as names in waypoints.json, but runway-to-procedure mapping for every RNAV SID, intermediate legs, and constraints are on the missing RJAA SID plates.

inHandScope.description: No additional procedure can be fully coded from the downloaded PDFs. The user-visible slice that can be completed with data in hand is a loadable RJTT VAMOS FOUR departure sample using procedures already coded in slice 1, without changing the default arrival START WITH SAMPLE, plus a schema/inventory file and a conflict/MSAW guard for that sample.

proposedDepartureSample.note: Choose a conflict-safe subset of runway variants and TATEYAMA/DRAKY transitions. Parallel 16L/16R or 34L/34R both rejoin at VAMOS and may STCA; if a guard test shows a conflict, reduce to a single departure (and optional already-enroute transition traffic that stays clear). Do not mix into the five-arrival default sample.

missingPlates.notRequiredForThisSlice: IAP, aerodrome, obstacle, visual, holding-pattern, MVA, and LDG charts are listed in chartIndex with codingStatus out-of-scope-this-slice and are not required to code SID/STAR.

crossCheck.note: RJTT AD 2.24 and RJAA AD 2.24 title lists in the full AD-2 PDFs match the eAIP HTML index titles. Filename numbers do not follow list order (e.g. VISIP is 2.24.88, GUSRO is 2.24.87, VAMOS is 2.24.12).
